title: Home composition, section-page behaviours, client-side search
goal: Finish the reading site: the home page summarises (hero + legend, 7 session cards, 10 best-10 cards, 3 track cards, progress rows, latest-feed widget), every section page has its kicker, legend, anchors, scrollspy, prev/next and reading-position restore, and the search box works from a build-time index with the `/` shortcut.
description: Template work on index.html and the section pages (OF-4, OF-5, OF-8, OF-10, DR-2, DR-9 wording), the client modules search.js/lib/score.js, sections.js (scrollspy, copy-link, read position), home.js + lib/format.js (latest feed widget, formatLastUpdated), and the `index` and `section` check groups in scripts/audit.py.
steps: Read FIRST: context.json, this file, plan.md Decisions 2, 3, 5, 10, 11, 19, design.md 'Page inventory' (Home, Section pages, Search, Keyboard, 404), ORCHESTRATOR FINDINGS OF-4/OF-5/OF-7/OF-8/OF-10, reviews/design-verdict.json DR-2, DR-9, mocks/home.html, mocks/section.html, FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 findings.

Home template (src/build/templates.js + home-data): hero sentence 'A source-checked learning-and-research roadmap for physical AI, robotics and autonomous drones, written for a software builder in India, with a personal progress tracker and a low-noise research feed.' (OF-4 — the word 'verified' never appears as a site descriptor), the cutoff line once ('Evidence cutoff 20 October 2026. …'), three buttons (Read from §0 → s00.html, Set up My plan → plan.html, Open the feed → feed.html); `.hero-grid` two columns from 1440 with `.hero-legend` 'Labels used throughout' (five chips + §0 meanings verbatim) on the right and nowhere else on the page (OF-5); 'Start this week' = 7 cards (checkbox s02:sessions:N, 'N. Session title', time, Output to keep, link 'What to do, in §2' → s02.html#t-s02-sessions-N); 'The best 10 resources' = 10 cards `.cards.best-10` (checkbox s03:best-10:N, h3 'N. ', purpose, time and cost, first link with .dom hint); 'Three tracks' = 3 cards from §14.1 (header cell as title; rows Fit profile / Month 24 outcome / Mandatory 24 h branch; the default marked with the report's own JUDGMENT chip 'Default: Track B'; link s14.html#s14-1); two columns from 1024: 'Your progress' (one `li[data-set]` per set with label, `0 of N`, `.bar > i`; overall line 'Overall 0 of N items (plan months are counted once a plan is chosen)' — DR-9) and 'Latest from the feed' (`
    ` + line 'Feed last updated . GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs.' + link to feed.html; noscript fallbacks for both).

Section templates: kicker 'Section N of 24' / 'Appendix A · part 21 of 24' (Decision 10); `<details class="legend">` under the h1 on all 24 pages (summary = the five chips; body = §0 meanings verbatim); `.anchor-h .copy` pills hidden until hover/`:focus-visible` via opacity (OF-10; stays in tab order); s00.html front matter block; collapsed `<details class="inline-rail">` 'Contents: 24 sections' above the article below 1024 and 'On this page · <set> N of M done' below 1440; right rail 'Keys' box (`/` search · `t` theme · `[` `]` previous/next); the §17.3 fenced query block gets a client-added 'Copy' button (Decision 11; the button is UI, not content).

assets/lib/score.js (pure): tokenise (lowercase, ASCII-fold, split on non-alphanumerics, drop 1-char tokens), score(record, terms) (all terms must match in h or x; title hits weigh 3, snippet hits 1, earlier position bonus), group by page in report order, cap 8 per group / 60 total, snippet with matched terms wrapped for <mark>.

assets/search.js: lazy-load search-index.json on first focus of the header input or `/`; `role=dialog` panel under the header with `aria-label="Search results"`; results grouped by section page, heading + snippet with <mark>; Enter opens the first hit; Esc closes and returns focus; arrow keys move between hits; no external service.

assets/sections.js: IntersectionObserver scrollspy sets `aria-current="true"` on the right-rail link of the h3 nearest the top (and the inline rail's summary text); copy-link buttons copy `location.href.split('#')[0] + '#id'` via navigator.clipboard with a brief 'Copied' label change; reading-position restore (Decision 3): on `pagehide` write `{ [page]: scrollY }` under KEYS.readpos; on load, when `location.hash` is empty and the stored value is a finite number ≤ scrollHeight, `scrollTo(0, value)`; the §17.3 Copy button.

assets/lib/format.js (pure): `formatLastUpdated(iso)` → 'D MMM YYYY, HH:mm UTC' (e.g. '21 Oct 2026, 02:31 UTC'); null/invalid → 'not yet'; `formatDate(iso)` → 'D MMM YYYY'. assets/home.js: fetch data/feed.json and data/meta.json with `cache: 'no-cache'`, render the 5 newest items whose id is not marked drop in KEYS.triage (title link with rel noopener external, source name, formatDate, matchedQuery or class), 'No feed items yet' when items is empty, set [data-last-updated] from formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt); progress rows are filled by FEAT-004's tracker.js (leave the data-set hooks).

scripts/audit.py: add GROUPS['index'] — `.hero-grid` has 2 children with non-empty text at ≥1440; 'Labels used throughout' occurs exactly once in body text; `.hero` text has no /verified/i; `document.title` has no /verified/i (also run on plan, feed, 404); the ten `.cards.best-10 h3` texts start with 'N. <DR-2 title>' for N = 1..10; best-10 geometry: distinct `left` counts 1 at 390, 2 at 1024 and 1440, 3 at 1920, 5 at 2560 with exactly 2 distinct `top` values at 2560 (OF-8); 'Evidence cutoff' occurs exactly twice in index body text (hero + footer) and once on other pages; the site name occurs once outside content (`.wordmark`). GROUPS['section'] (s12, s03, s15, appendix-a): kicker text matches /^(Section \d+ of 24|Appendix [A-D] · part \d+ of 24)$/; `.legend` present with 5 `.chip`; `.copy` computed opacity 0 at rest and 1 after `.focus()`; right-rail 'On this page' link count == article h3 count; after `scrollIntoView` of the third h3, its rail link has aria-current=true (allow 500 ms); prev/next hrefs exist in dist; OF-7: at 390 and 2560 every text node outside <a> inside `.article` has computed colour equal to the `--fg` token value, and `.article a` count equals the markdown link count passed in via the report's per-page metadata (verify.mjs exports it); reading position: on s06 `scrollTo(0,1500)` → `pagehide` (navigate away and back) → `scrollY` within ±50 px of 1500; search: press `/` → active element is the search input; type 'quadrotor' → ≥1 result group; Enter → navigation to a page whose text contains 'quadrotor'; Esc closes the panel.

Tests: tests/score.test.js (tokenise, ranking order, group caps), tests/format.test.js (fixed ISO → exact string; null → 'not yet'), tests/home-template.test.js (render index from the real content into a string: hero sentence present, 'verified' absent from the hero, legend once, 7 + 10 + 3 cards, overall-line wording, no style attributes).

Run `npm test`, `npm run build`, `npm run verify` (7 page types; add `--all` if time allows). Fix ANY hard-UI-rule violation found on ANY page, in scope or not, and report it. Update status.md, set this file's status to completed, record findings (search-index.json size, card counts, anything FEAT-004 needs about the progress rows and data-set ids).
Commit on main: `feat(FEAT-003): home composition, section-page behaviours, client-side search` with the commands and results in the body. Never push.

acceptance.outcome: The home page summarises the report with real cards and no duplicated facts (OF-4, OF-5, OF-8, DR-2, DR-9).
acceptance.audit: index group: hero halves both carry content at 1920/2560; legend once; hero has no 'verified'; ten best-10 h3 titles exact; 5 columns × 2 rows at 2560, 1 column at 390; 'Evidence cutoff' exactly twice; overall-line wording matches.

acceptance.outcome: Every section page has kicker, legend, anchors, working rails and prev/next (D6 legend on every page, OF-10).
acceptance.audit: section group on s03/s12/s15/appendix-a: kicker regex; .legend with 5 chips on all 24 pages (crawl); .copy opacity 0 → 1 on focus; on-this-page count == h3 count; scrollspy aria-current after scrolling; prev/next resolve.

acceptance.outcome: Prose links exist only where the markdown has a link; prose colour is uniform (OF-7).

acceptance.outcome: Search works offline from the build-time index.

commit: feat(FEAT-003): home composition, section-page behaviours, client-side search
findings:
COMMIT: feat(FEAT-003) on main; the hash is recorded by the follow-up docs(FEAT-003) commit (a commit cannot contain its own hash — same procedure as FEAT-001/002).
BUILD SUMMARY (npm run build): pages 28 · h3 89 · chips 127 · crossrefs 113 rewritten / 5 skipped · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 · search 965 records · bytes 1194838. search-index.json 315,291 bytes (cap 512,000; unchanged from FEAT-001 — the index format was not touched). dist ≈ 1.19 MB.
TESTS: npm test = 88 tests / 19 files, all pass, ≈2 s, no network. New: tests/score.test.js (tokenise, term matching incl. prefix-not-infix, heading-over-text and early-hit ranking, per-group cap 8 / total cap 60 / report order, snippet window + <mark> parts, the real index answers 'quadrotor' only with pages that contain the term), tests/format.test.js (fixed ISO → '21 Oct 2026, 02:31 UTC', offsets converted to UTC, null/invalid → 'not yet'; formatDate UTC, invalid → ''), tests/home-template.test.js (renders index.html from the real content: hero sentence once, cutoff line once, three buttons, no 'verified' in hero/title/body, 'Labels used throughout' once inside .hero-grid with 5 chips and no details.legend, 7 + 10 + 3 cards with checkbox ids and links, ten h3 == 'N. <DR-2 title>', 10 .dom hints, Default JUDGMENT chip: Track B, 9 progress rows with their totals, DR-9 overall wording, #latest-feed + the hidden feed note, zero style attributes, latestItems ordering/dropping).
VERIFY (npm run verify, 7 page types × 320/360/390/820/1024/1440/1920/2560 × light/dark): PASS, 2081 checks, 0 failures, 46 s. npm run verify -- --all: PASS, 28 pages, 5462 checks, 0 failures, 114.9 s (generic minima unchanged: contrast 4.87 light / 7.12 dark, text 12.75 px, body 17.00 px at 320–390 / 22.00 at 2560, content ratio 0.93, gutters = clamp, controls 40–44, [style] 0, CSP violations 0). Crawl 28 pages · 2041 internal refs · 0 broken · 46 prev/next. New group numbers — home: hero halves 2 children with 372/679 chars, distinct lefts 1 at ≤1024 and 2 at 1440/1920/2560 (widths 646/862/949 px); 'Labels used throughout' ×1; .hero has no 'verified'; titles 'Physical AI Roadmap' / 'My plan — …' / 'Feed — …' have no 'verified'; ten best-10 h3 exact; best-10 distinct lefts 1/1/1/2/2/2/3/5 at 320…2560 with exactly 2 distinct tops at 2560 (5 × 2); session cards 1/1/1/2/2/2/3/4 columns, track cards 1/1/1/2/2/2/3/3; 'Evidence cutoff' ×2 on index, ×1 outside content on every other page; site name ×1 (.wordmark); overall line 'Overall 0 of 122 items (plan months are counted once a plan is chosen). Stored in this browser only.'; feed widget 'No feed items yet.' + 'Feed last updated not yet. GitHub may delay or skip scheduled runs.' (note unhidden by home.js). Section (s03/s12/s15/appendix-a × 8 widths × 2 themes): kicker regex; legend 5 summary chips + 5 definitions; .copy opacity 0 → 1 after focus() → 0 after blur (:focus-visible matches script focus in headless msedge); on-this-page rail and inline link counts == h3 count (s03 0, s12 6, s15 7, appendix-a 0); scrollspy: scrollIntoView of the third h3 → its link carries aria-current within 500 ms in both rails and no other does (s12 #s12-3, s15 #s15-3; pages without h3 report 'no h3'); prev/next: <link rel> targets HEAD 200 and equal the .prevnext hrefs; OF-7 link parity at 390 and 2560: s03 21/21, s12 19/19, s15 0/0, appendix-a 0/0 (reference computed by verify.mjs linkCounts() from content/roadmap.md and passed as --link-counts); prose colour: 0 of 55 text nodes off-colour on s12 and body colour == --fg token (#16191d light / #e4e7eb dark). Specials: reading position on s06 (scrollTo 1500 → navigate away → return → scrollY 1500; stored {"s06.html":1500}; with #s6-3 the heading lands at 75 px from the top instead), clipboard on s17 (copy-link pill → clipboard 'http://…/s17.html#s17-1', hash set, label 'Copied' → 'link' after 1.5 s; code Copy → 742 chars starting 'THESIS NARROW', label 'Copied'; the Windows clipboard returns CRLF, normalised in the check), search at 1440 and 390 ('/' focuses #search — at 390 it also reveals the box — 'quadrotor' → 8 groups / 17 hits / 20 <mark>, status '17 results in 8 sections · Enter opens the first', panel role=dialog aria-label='Search results' directly under the header (top 56 / 122 px), no horizontal overflow, ArrowDown focuses the first hit, second ArrowDown the second, ArrowUp ×2 returns to the input, Esc hides the panel and leaves body focused and collapses the revealed box, '/' reopens with the kept query, Enter navigates to s01.html#the-ten-decisions whose text contains the term).
HOME DOM FOR FEAT-004/005: progress rows unchanged from FEAT-001 — ul.progress-list > li[data-set=ID] > span (label) + span.count > span[data-done] 'of' span[data-total] + div.bar > i[data-bar]; data-set ids sessions (7), best-10 (10), reading-map (36), modules (12), books (14), media (26), rungs (9), gates (8), plan (24; FEAT-004 resolves it to plan-10h/plan-20h once a plan is chosen); p.progress-note > span[data-overall-done] / span[data-overall-total] (122 = 114 + 8 gates; plan months excluded until chosen). Latest feed: ol.feed-list#latest-feed (was ul[data-latest-feed] in FEAT-001) filled by assets/home.js with li.feed-brief > h3 > a[rel='noopener external'] + div.meta > span (source) span (formatDate publishedAt, UTC) span (matchedQuery || sourceClass); items whose KEYS.triage entry has state 'drop' are skipped; newest 5 by publishedAt; empty → li.feed-brief 'No feed items yet.'; fetch failure → 'The feed data could not be loaded.'; p.feed-note[data-feed-updated] is emitted hidden and unhidden after span[data-last-updated] = formatLastUpdated(meta.generatedAt ?? feed.generatedAt). The same data-done/data-track hooks exist on the 7 + 10 home cards (checkbox aria-label 'Done: <title>').
CLIENT API: assets/app.js imports initSearch (every page) and dispatches home → home.js, section → sections.js; plan/feed slots are still null. assets/search.js exports initSearch(keys) (sets keys.search = focusInput and keys.escape = escape), run, open, close, escape, focusInput, ensureIndex; the panel is div.search-panel#search-panel[role=dialog][aria-label='Search results'][hidden] appended to header.site-header (absolute, top 100%, right gutter, width min(46rem, 100% − 2 gutters), max-height min(70vh, 44rem)); groups section.search-group > h3 (page title) + ol > li > a[href='page#anchor'] > span.hit-h + span.hit-x with <mark>; MIN_CHARS 2; input gets aria-controls/aria-expanded. assets/lib/score.js (pure): fold, tokenise, termsOf, prepareIndex, matchToken (exact 2 / prefix 1), scoreRecord (heading hit ×3, text hits ≤3 × 1 or 0.75 for prefix, early-hit bonus 1/(1+i/8); 0 when any term is missing), pageOrder, pageTitles, search(index, query, {perGroup 8, total 60}) → {terms, matched, shown, groups[{page, s, title, hits}]}, snippetAround (160 chars around the first hit), highlight → [{text, mark}]. assets/lib/format.js (pure): parseDate, formatDate ('D MMM YYYY' UTC, '' when invalid), formatLastUpdated ('D MMM YYYY, HH:mm UTC', 'not yet' when absent/invalid) — the ONE derivation of the visible last-updated text (D9); FEAT-005's feed page must import it. assets/sections.js exports init, initScrollspy (returns the update fn), initCopyLinks, initCodeCopy, saveReadingPosition, restoreReadingPosition; scrollspy rule = last .prose h3.anchor-h whose top ≤ header bottom + 2rem (first h3 when none), recomputed on IntersectionObserver callbacks, scroll and resize; aria-current='true' on matching links in .rail-right and .onpage-inline; readpos value {'<file>.html': scrollY} written on pagehide. Copy buttons: div.code-block > div.code-tools > button.btn.copy-code 'Copy' + the pre (42 px, hidden in print).
CSS HOOKS ADDED (assets/app.css): .search-panel/.search-status/.search-group/.hit-h/.hit-x, mark (--bg-3 fill, --fg text, weight 650), .code-block/.code-tools, .feed-brief (+ .meta), .feed-note margin, .site-header.search-open .search-box (<860 px: the box takes its own header row, input shown; cursor pointer on the collapsed icon), print hides .search-panel and .code-tools. No transition/animation/shadow/gradient (tests/css.test.js); the panel uses width: min(…) because the test bans max-width below 100rem.
DECISIONS TAKEN HERE (not covered by D1–D11 / plan Decisions): (a) Copy buttons on all four .prose pre blocks (§3 bash command — the report itself calls it 'Copyable' —, §16.3 lab-note template, §17.3 queries and include rules), placed in a toolbar row above the block so nothing overlaps the code on phones; Decision 11 named §17.3 as the motivating case. (b) Pages with no h3 (s02, s03, s04, s09, appendix-a…d) do not render the empty right-rail 'On this page' block; the inline details rail is rendered only when the page has h3s or trackable sets (appendices now have neither block). (c) The audit GROUPS key for the home page is 'home' (body[data-page='home']); FEAT-002's placeholder key 'index' could never match, so the index group is registered under 'home'. plan/feed/404 got shell_text_checks (titleNoVerified, cutoffCount 1, siteNameOnce). (d) Esc closes the panel AND blurs the input (document.activeElement → body) — consistent with FEAT-002's keys audit; focus returns to the input from a hit via ArrowUp. (e) Result links are --fg (like rail links) and <mark> uses --bg-3/--fg so accent text never sits on --bg-3 (design contrast rule). (f) The inline rail's summary text is not changed by the scrollspy (the collapsed box is scrolled away when the reader is deep in the page); FEAT-004 appends its '· <set> N of M done' there as designed. (g) formatDate uses UTC like formatLastUpdated. (h) Search terms match token prefixes ('quadrot' finds quadrotor) but not infixes; one-character terms are dropped; the status line says 'N results in M sections · Enter opens the first' or 'No results for “q”.'; records with a='top' show the heading only. (i) The §17.3 fenced blocks keep their long single lines (pre scrolls horizontally inside the column; no wrapping), so the copied text is byte-exact.
SHELL FIX BEYOND SCOPE (reported): search was unreachable at 360–859 px — the header shows a 42 px icon whose <input> is display:none, so neither clicking it nor '/' could focus anything, and below 360 px the nav-strip 'Search' link pointed at the hidden #search. Now the icon, the '/' key (keys.search = focusInput) and the strip link add .search-open to the header, which gives the box its own full-width header row with the input visible; Esc removes it. Audited in the search special at 390 (focused.visible true, open true). No D2–D6/OF/DR violation was found on any of the 28 pages by the generic thresholds.
CAVEATS FOR LATER FEATS: the clipboard special grants clipboard-read/write to the served origin (http://127.0.0.1:<port>); on --live (FEAT-007) the same grant applies to the Pages origin. The search special navigates from index to the first hit's page (currently s01.html#the-ten-decisions); if content edits change the ranking, the check still passes as long as the landing page contains the term. The copyFocus check relies on :focus-visible matching a script focus() in headless msedge (true today; if a future Playwright/Edge changes the heuristic, press Tab before focus()). verify.mjs now imports src/build/parse.js (linkCounts) — a build failure would surface there before the audit. The feedWidget check accepts both the placeholder state ('No feed items yet.') and real data (1–5 li; note matching formatLastUpdated's pattern), so FEAT-005 needs no audit change for the home widget; it should add its own feed-page checks under GROUPS['feed'] (the shell_text_checks entry is already there — append, do not replace).
